newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bankers Trust wins US$250 mln currency portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust wins US$250 mln currency portfolio.

text.p: Bankers Trust Funds Management said on Tuesday that it had been awarded a mandate from the Hong Kong Hospital Authority Provident Fund Scheme (HAPFS) to manage a US$250 million currency overlay portfolio.
BT Fund Managers will manage the currency exposure of the hospital authority's equity investments in Hong Kong, the United States, Europe, Japan and Southeast Asia.
"We will undertake extensive research on identifying the major macroeconomics forces affecting currencies and the subsequent themes that flow from these," said BT Fund Manager director Anthony Fasso.
"We expect that in the next 12 months many Asian institutions will be looking to appoint specialist currency managers to better manage their currency exposures," he said.
The portfolio will be managed by the company's currency team in Sydney, which manages a total of US$5 billion in integrated and stand-alone currency overlay accounts.
Bankers Trust manages US$218 billion worldwide.
